WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) as total_points,
    COUNT(*) as entry_count
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_entries FROM stats
)
SELECT 
  s.nationality,
  s.total_points,
  s.entry_count,
  ROUND(a.avg_entries, 2) as avg_entries,
  ROUND(s.entry_count - a.avg_entries, 2) as diff_from_avg
FROM stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_stats a
ORDER BY s.total_points DESC
